voiceover: It's 3am. You tell yourself one last commit. Just a tiny fix, no need to test it. You push, the page loads, you close the laptop. You feel like a genius. Then you wake up, read your own code, and don't recognize a single line. Nothing is wrong with you. Tired brains write confident bugs. Sleep is a free debugger. Send this to the person still up pushing code.
